summary.intent: Execute phase 60 (IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout) using the GSD wave-based parallel execution workflow, then run the full ship-phase loop to get the PR up and through CI.
summary.outcome: All 7 code plans (waves 1–3) executed and gated green locally; the SDK E2E gate caught a ship-blocking regression from 60-05 (Ed25519 pubKey stripped from resolve response) that 343 unit tests missed — fixed and confirmed 89/89 E2E pass. Phase 60-08 (staging cutover) remains at a human-action checkpoint; committing and shipping are blocked on a wedged 1Password SSH signer.

repo: Ed25519 IPNS records do NOT embed the public key in the record protobuf bytes — `parseIpnsRecordBytes` yields no `pubKey` for these records. The API must supply it from the validated `publicKey` DB column (enforced at publish via `deriveIpnsName(publicKey) === ipnsName`).

60-05's `D-06 enrich removal` was based on a false assumption ('pubKey is already embedded in the signed record'). The deleted `withCachedPublicKey` and equal-seq enrich were load-bearing for the strict publish→resolve round-trip.

The 60-05 unit test mocking `parseIpnsRecord` WITH `pubKey` masked the Ed25519 real-world case where it's absent — the SDK E2E gate (real client→API round-trip) is the only suite that catches this class of boundary regression.
The TS resolve path did not fail-closed on an absent `Validity` field (only enforced EOL when `Validity` was a `Uint8Array`) while Rust fail-closes on absent Validity — a D-07 cross-layer parity gap.
CAPACITY.md §1.5 was already occupied by a prior-phase re-baseline; the D-11 verify-cache measurement landed as §1.6.

GSD executors do not always commit `Cargo.lock` when `Cargo.toml` dependencies change — 60-01 added `ciborium`+`cipherbox-core` to `api-client` without committing the lockfile, creating a latent `--locked` CI break.
GSD executors can leave stale SUMMARY footers and un-ticked ROADMAP checkboxes; the orchestrator must reconcile these after each wave.
The `subject-no-parens` commitlint rule rejects trailing `(D-XX)` in commit subjects — one 60-01 commit had `(D-07)` and needed rewording before the PR.

Wave-based worktree-isolated subagent execution was dropped in favor of sequential executors on the main branch because there is no reliable way to merge back `isolation="worktree"` agent branches from the harness.

code.finding: Strict resolve requires `pubKey`, `signatureV2`, and `data` all present in the response and verifies `deriveIpnsName(pubKey) === ipnsName`. Any resolve path that strips sig fields triggers the fail-closed throw.

EOL/expiry enforcement was gated on `Validity instanceof Uint8Array`, silently accepting records with no Validity field at all. Fixed to throw when Validity is absent (mirroring Rust `ipns.rs:114-117`).

On equal-sequence path, `resolveRecord` was returning the bare network `result` from `parseIpnsRecordBytes` — which lacks `pubKey` for Ed25519. Fix: serve the full DB `cachedResult` on equal-or-higher sequence so the strict client receives all sig fields.

The D-06 unit test mocked `parseIpnsRecord` to include `pubKey` (unrealistic for Ed25519) and then asserted `signatureV2`/`data` are `undefined` on equal-seq — effectively codifying the regression. Test was updated to reflect the corrected strict-verifiable behavior.
`parseCachedRecord` needed a `pubKey` field populated from the DB `publicKey` column; the network record bytes alone are insufficient to reconstruct a verifiable Ed25519 IPNS record.

workflow: The SDK E2E gate (`tests/sdk-e2e`) is the only suite that exercises the real client→API IPNS publish/resolve round-trip. Unit suites mock the boundary and miss integration regressions — this gate caught a 28/89 break (phase 60) and a 48/89 break (phase 51) that all other gates missed.
The GSD commit helper has a known false-negative: it reports `commit_failed` while the commit actually lands. Always verify with `git log --oneline -1` before retrying.

1Password SSH signer can wedge after many rapid commits (`op-ssh-sign: failed to fill whole buffer`). Recovery: quit and reopen the 1Password desktop app or toggle Settings → Developer → SSH agent off/on.
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL). Patch PR body via `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file` instead.
Run SDK E2E before pushing IPNS-touching phases — the prereqs (postgres 5432, kubo 5001, redis 6380, mock-ipns-routing 3001) must all be up and the full client+API chain must be rebuilt from source.

friction: 1Password SSH signer wedged after ~28 rapid phase commits (`op-ssh-sign: failed to fill whole buffer`), blocking all subsequent commits and the push. Requires user to restart the desktop app.
GSD commit helper false-negatives (reports `commit_failed` when the commit lands) required repeated `git log` verification and caused uncertainty throughout.

60-01's executor committed Cargo.toml dependency additions but not the resulting Cargo.lock update, leaving a latent `--locked` CI break that had to be caught and committed by the orchestrator mid-wave-2.
60-01's executor appended a stale footer to `60-01-SUMMARY.md` after the SUMMARY commit; the footer became factually wrong after 60-04 deleted `verify.rs` and had to be manually reverted.
60-06's executor did not tick its ROADMAP checkbox; the orchestrator had to detect and reconcile this after wave 3.

The worktree-isolation execution path (parallel subagents, each in their own worktree) was evaluated and discarded mid-session because there is no reliable branch-manifest/merge-back from `isolation="worktree"` agents in the harness — traded wall-clock for correctness.
